annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2020/561 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 April 2020 amending Regulation (EU) 2017/745 on medical devices, as regards the dates of application of certain of its provisions
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2020/561 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 23 April 2020 amending Regulation (EU) 2017/745 on medical devices, as regards the dates of application of certain of its provisions
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union, L 130
annotation.summary_en: EU Regulation 2020/561 postpones by one year (to 26 May 2021) the application of key provisions of the Medical Devices Regulation 2017/745 because of the COVID-19 crisis. It adjusts transitional provisions and enables Union-wide extension of national derogations for vital devices. It contains no AI or robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defers application dates of Regulation (EU) 2017/745 from 26 May 2020 to 26 May 2021
Allows Commission to extend national derogations to Union-wide validity via implementing acts
Adjusts transitional provisions for devices certified under Directives 90/385/EEC and 93/42/EEC
Article 59 on derogations applies from 24 April 2020
Enters into force on the day of publication
